messages.subject: Re: Choropleth mapping service??
parts:
Sarah, 

I can try and help, but I can't guarantee we'll get there in your timeline. From the forum though it looks as though this sort of thing has been done before. 

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!topic/ggplot2/oC7-MVyWN7I

You can see an example of using the county map for the USA here: 

http://docs.ggplot2.org/0.9.2.1/fortify.map.html

Or:
require(maps)
require(ggplot2)
USA <- map("county", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE)
qplot(long, lat, data = USA, geom = "polygon", group = group, colour = I("white"))

Sadly, I'm unfamiliar with mapping databases (FIPS), so I'm not sure how you get your data into the right format, but if you send it and whatever R code you have so far, myself or others can have a play and hopefully get you on your way. 

Brandon
